# Nesim Apps

> Small, mostly ad-supported games and utility apps for Android and iPhone by independent developer Nesim Razon, published on Google Play and the App Store. Pages are available in Turkish, English, Spanish and Portuguese.

## Games

- [Slinglings](https://nesimapps.com/slinglings/): Sling cute couriers through space, bend shots around planets, deliver the mail!
- [Snowlings](https://nesimapps.com/snowlings/): A winter calendar for December: a new door every day, 6 winter puzzle games, greeting cards and a New Year countdown.
- [Tombalings](https://nesimapps.com/tombalings/): Tombala (90 balls) and Bingo (75 balls): a cheerful number race against cute rivals. No real money, free play.
- [Brassline](https://nesimapps.com/brassline/): Blackjack, European roulette and Texas Hold'em with play chips. 18+, no real money, entertainment only.
- [Nuzzlings](https://nesimapps.com/nuzzlings/): Adopt a kitten, cuddle it, feed it and watch it grow up. Cozy and calm.
- [Pentolings](https://nesimapps.com/pentolings/): Fit and Drop: two cute puzzle games in one app. Fill shapes with pieces, pop the colours.
- [Nudgelings](https://nesimapps.com/nudgelings/): Slide and Push: two cute puzzle games in one app, 400 levels.
- [Grumblings](https://nesimapps.com/grumblings/): Outsmart the grumpy monster: a turn-based maze puzzle with 300 levels in 30 worlds.
- [Tilelings](https://nesimapps.com/tilelings/): Cute Mahjong Solitaire, Connect and Tile Match puzzles. New ones every day!
- [Logiclings](https://nesimapps.com/logiclings/): Three new logic puzzles every day from five kinds: Crown, Twin, Path, Sleepy Faces and Frog Hops. No timers, just cute faces.
- [Cardles](https://nesimapps.com/cardles/): Klondike, Spider, FreeCell & TriPeaks with cute faces. Daily challenge!
- [Beamies](https://nesimapps.com/beamies/): Slide gates to beam cute aliens home. 400 levels from the Moon to the Galaxy!
- [Cubbles](https://nesimapps.com/cubbles/): A block puzzle with cute faces: drag blocks onto the board, fill rows and columns to clear them and chain combos. Daily challenge, quests and themes.
- [Sliplines](https://nesimapps.com/sliplines/): An arrow puzzle game: slide the arrows out in the right order and clear the board. Hundreds of levels, a Daily Puzzle with a global leaderboard, and badges to collect.
- [2048](https://nesimapps.com/game2048/): The classic number puzzle: swipe, merge matching numbers and reach the 2048 tile.
- [Tic-Tac-Toe](https://nesimapps.com/tictactoe/): Classic Tic-Tac-Toe against the computer: Easy, Medium or Hard. On Hard it never loses.

## Apps

- [Hafta Sonum](https://nesimapps.com/haftasonum/): What to do this weekend? Theatre, concerts, exhibitions and kids' events in your city on one screen, no account or location needed (Turkish only, Turkey).
- [Çalışan Asistanı](https://nesimapps.com/calisan/): Net salary, severance and notice pay, overtime and leave planning in one app, for employees in Turkey (Turkish only), with a friendly payslip assistant.
- [Astrolings](https://nesimapps.com/astrolings/): Your zodiac sign's daily companion: daily readings, a Moon calendar, sign compatibility and 12 cute zodiac creatures (Turkish only).
- [Uzay Günlüğü](https://nesimapps.com/uzaygunlugu/): A new space card every day, Turkey from space, the spinning Earth and the live position of the ISS, built on NASA's public data (Turkish only).
- [Pulselings](https://nesimapps.com/pulselings/): Check your resting pulse with your camera and flash; calm, private, no account. Not a medical device.
- [Şans Oyunları](https://nesimapps.com/sansoyunlari/): Results of the Turkish lotteries (Sayısal Loto, Süper Loto, Şans Topu, On Numara, Milli Piyango), random tickets and ticket checking.
- [Where Am I?](https://nesimapps.com/whereami/): See where you are on the map with your address and coordinates; explore places and photos nearby.
- [Age Calculator](https://nesimapps.com/agecalculator/): Calculate exact age and the time between dates, and keep a list of birthdays and anniversaries.
- [Son Depremler](https://nesimapps.com/sondepremler/): Recent earthquakes in and around Turkey from AFAD and Kandilli, with a map and statistics.
- [BMI Calculator](https://nesimapps.com/bmicalculator/): Calculate your BMI with WHO categories and see the healthy weight range for your height.
- [National Anthem of Turkey](https://nesimapps.com/anthemturkey/): İstiklal Marşı, the national anthem of Türkiye, with a waving flag; plays in the background and on Chromecast.
- [National Anthem of Canada](https://nesimapps.com/anthemcanada/): O Canada, the national anthem of Canada, with a waving flag; plays in the background and on Chromecast.
- [TurkSail](https://nesimapps.com/turksail/): Sailing and sea news, race results and articles from turksail.com (in Turkish).
- [MedyaFobi](https://nesimapps.com/medyafobi/): Media relations, crisis communication and speaking trainings from medyafobi.com (in Turkish).

## Policies

- Each app has a privacy policy at /<app>/privacy.html and terms of use at /<app>/terms.html.
- [Website privacy](https://nesimapps.com/site-privacy.html)
